# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

We welcome constructive collaboration on Rails engineering, accessible UI, secure multi-tenant support and responsible AI assistance.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and specific in technical reviews.
- Explain a bug or design concern with reproducible facts.
- Treat contributors fairly regardless of experience or background.
- Protect private security reports, customer records and credentials.
- Give credit to upstream projects, authors and licenses.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, personal attacks, publishing private information without authorization, deceptive benchmark claims, submitting real customer data without consent, or intentionally weakening security controls are not acceptable.

## Reporting

For community-conduct concerns, contact the maintainer privately at **i.am@dangkhoa.dev**. For vulnerabilities, follow [Security](SECURITY.md).

The maintainer may moderate discussions, close issues, reject changes or restrict participation for repeated violations. These guidelines apply to repository discussions, issues, pull requests and related project spaces.
